sources.evidence: Designed for Mac mini M4, this mini dock features a 10 Gbps USB-C host port, 1 × HDMI 2.0 4K 60Hz, 2 × USB-A 3.2 10 Gbps

missing: Measured SSD speeds and drive temperatures compared across the stand docks (Ugreen, Satechi, iVANKY, Anyoyo), along with current prices, so a shopper can tell whether the 10Gbps limit or poor cooling matters when choosing one.
why: Macworld is the one major reviewer that answers this. It hands-on reviewed the Ugreen SSD dock and covers several docks in an updated upgrade guide, so it answers the question in part. No second major reviewer compares these docks with its own testing. TechRadar and Tom's Guide show up, but their pages are about the Mac mini itself. The rest are untested Amazon-widget roundups, one product page from a maker, an off-target page about standalone enclosures, and Bitdoze, a niche site that compares specs. A page that tests and compares the docks could get in, but it would be up against Macworld.
